about: Where every file in brand/ came from, with its SHA-256. build.py refreshes the hashes.

README.md.source: the usage sheet, written when the brand home landed (2026-09-28)

brand.json.source: written for this brand home (2026-09-28): the icon block names the masters and the generated favicon, the outputs block names the two surfaces that copy from brand/

og/mark-og.png.source: moved from static/og.png when the brand home landed (2026-09-28); added in 1106f9e (2026-09-26, PR #82) with no source found: the commit adds the PNG alone and no script, HTML or SVG in the repository draws it. Raster master only; the gap is recorded in brand/README.md

svg/mark-app-icon.svg.source: moved from static/favicon.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28); added in 1106f9e (2026-09-26, PR #82) as the studio favicon, byte for byte

svg/mark-maskable.svg.source: derived from svg/mark-app-icon.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28): the same tile with the 25% corner radius dropped so it fills the 32x32 canvas, for the maskable and Apple touch icons

svg/mark-symbol-black.svg.source: derived from svg/mark-symbol.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28): every fill and stroke set to #000000

svg/mark-symbol-on-dark.svg.source: derived from svg/mark-app-icon.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28): the M stroke alone, stroke #FFFFFF (the master writes it #fff)

svg/mark-symbol-white.svg.source: derived from svg/mark-symbol.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28): every fill and stroke set to #FFFFFF (the same drawing as mark-symbol-on-dark.svg)

svg/mark-symbol.svg.source: derived from svg/mark-app-icon.svg when the brand home landed (2026-09-28): the M stroke alone, viewBox tight to the stroke (7.7 9.2 16.6 14.1), stroke #0B0C10

tokens.json.source: read from the studio theme variables in static/index.html and from the logo master when the brand home landed (2026-09-28)
